thread.title: Universal Display stock soars after report says Apple will use OLED screens in all new iPhone models next year

author: morningstar.com
title: Universal Display stock soars after report says Apple will use OLED screens in all new iPhone models next year
text:
Shares of Universal Display Corp. (OLED) are up 15% in Tuesday morning trading after a report from South Korea's Economic Times indicated that Apple Inc. (AAPL) plans to put organic light-emitting diode (OLED) screens in all three of the iPhone models it will introduce next year. The report cited unnamed industry sources. Shares of LG Display Co. Ltd. (034220.SE), another OLED-panel maker, are up 4% in morning trading, while shares of Japan Display Inc. , which makes liquid-crystal display (LCD) screens fell 8% in Tuesday's session. Currently Apple uses OLED screens for its premium iPhone X and uses Samsung Electronics Co. as its supplier. Apple didn't immediately respond to MarketWatch's request for comment. Apple shares are down 0.4% in Tuesday trading but up 23% over the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average has gained 17%.
